TRIALS, PRICE AND THE MRR CLOCK | G4-G6
+-- Surge (Q2 2020-Q1 2021)
|   +-- [S] 90-day trial: Mar 21-May 31; 14-day resumed June 1.
|   +-- [S] Both converted in Q3 2020: "double cohort" effect.
|   `-- [S] Plus excluded; Standard outgrew Plus in MRR.
+-- Reckoning (Q3 2022-Q2 2023)
|   +-- [S] Trial merchants immaterial to MRR until full conversion.
|   +-- [S] Q1 2023: more first sales and weekly active sales.
|   +-- [S] Standard repricing: Jan announcement, late Apr existing.
|   +-- [S] Q2 MRR $139M vs Q1 $116M; price largest dollar driver.
|   `-- [S] Plus share fell to 29% as Standard repriced.
+-- Focused compounding (Q3 2023-Q1 2025)
|   +-- [S] 2024 Plus: majority lock 2023 rates for three years.
|   +-- [S] Q1 2024 MRR counts full price only after payment.
|   |   `-- [S] Previously counted at trial end; no revenue impact.
|   +-- [S] Q2 2024: one-month trials help subscription growth.
|   `-- [S] Q4 2024: three-month rollout begins in selected markets.
+-- Reacceleration (Q2 2025 onward)
|   +-- [S] Largest-market rollout ends Q1 2025; Q2 MRR growth 9%.
|   +-- [S] Q3 2025: trial comparisons + Plus price lapping weigh.
|   +-- [S] Q1 2026: final trial-comparison headwind; MRR +16%.
|   `-- [S] Q2 and Q3 2026 MRR +19%.
+-- Reading the signal
    trial length -[assoc]-> MRR growth
    price -[claim]-> retention resilience
    [I] MRR is not a clean merchant-count or retention proxy.
    [I] Trial test methods and seed's GMV-milestone result absent.
